(function(){
const C=window.CONFIG,P=window.PRODUCTS;
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const price=p=>p.base+(p.markup==null?C.MARKUP:p.markup);
const AR=window.AREAS;
const IM=p=>(window.IMGS||{})[p.id]||"";
let LIVE=null;
const key=(p,o)=>p.id+"|"+o.join("|");
const vars=p=>LIVE?p.variants.map(v=>[v[0],LIVE[key(p,v[0])]||0]).filter(v=>v[1]>0):p.variants;
async function loadStock(){try{const r=await fetch(C.STOCK_URL+"&_="+Date.now());const t=await r.text();const j=JSON.parse(t.slice(t.indexOf("{"),t.lastIndexOf("}")+1));const m={};j.table.rows.forEach(x=>{if(x.c[0]&&x.c[1])m[x.c[0].v]=x.c[1].v});if(Object.keys(m).length){LIVE=m;return true}}catch(e){}return false}
let cart=[];try{cart=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("cart")||"[]")}catch(e){}
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem("cart",JSON.stringify(cart))}catch(e){}};
const fmt=n=>n.toLocaleString("ar-EG")+" "+C.CURRENCY;
let cat="الكل";
function cats(){const cs=["الكل",...new Set(P.map(p=>p.cat))];$("#cats").innerHTML=cs.map(c=>`<button class="chip ${c===cat?"on":""}" data-c="${c}">${c}<\/button>`).join("");}
function card(p){return `<article class="pcard"><img src="${IM(p)}" alt="${p.name}" loading="lazy"><div class="pb"><h3>${p.name}<\/h3><div class="pr">${fmt(price(p))}<\/div>${vars(p).length?`<button class="btn sm" data-id="${p.id}">اختار واطلب<\/button>`:`<button class="btn sm" disabled>نفذت الكمية<\/button>`}<\/div><\/article>`}
function grid(){const cs=cat==="الكل"?[...new Set(P.map(p=>p.cat))]:[cat];$("#grid").innerHTML=cs.map(c=>`<h3 class="csec" id="cat-${c}">${c}<\/h3><div class="pgrid">${P.filter(p=>p.cat===c).map(card).join("")}<\/div>`).join("")}
function openProduct(id){const p=P.find(x=>x.id===id);const names=p.optnames;
$("#pm").innerHTML=`<div class="mbox"><button class="x" data-close>×<\/button><img src="${IM(p)}" alt="${p.name}"><h2>${p.name}<\/h2><div class="pr">${fmt(price(p))}<\/div>${(window.DESC&&DESC[p.id])?`<div class="desc">${DESC[p.id].replace(/[<>&]/g,"")}<\/div>`:""}<div class="opts">${names.map((k,i)=>`<label>${k}<select data-i="${i}"><\/select><\/label>`).join("")}<label>الكمية<input id="qty" type="number" min="1" max="10" value="1"><\/label><\/div><div id="pmsg" class="err"><\/div><button class="btn" id="add">أضف للسلة<\/button><\/div>`;$("#pm").classList.add("open");
const sels=[...document.querySelectorAll("#pm select")];
function fill(i){const prefix=sels.slice(0,i).map(s=>s.value);const vals=[...new Set(vars(p).filter(v=>prefix.every((x,j)=>v[0][j]===x)).map(v=>v[0][i]))];const cur=sels[i].value;sels[i].innerHTML=vals.map(x=>`<option value="${x}" ${x===cur?"selected":""}>${x.replace(/^\./,"")}<\/option>`).join("");if(i+1<sels.length)fill(i+1);}
sels.forEach((s,i)=>s.onchange=()=>{if(i+1<sels.length)fill(i+1)});fill(0);
$("#add").onclick=()=>{const opts={};sels.forEach(s=>opts[names[+s.dataset.i]]=s.value);const vr=vars(p).find(v=>names.every((n,j)=>v[0][j]===opts[n]));const q=Math.max(1,Math.min(10,Math.floor(+$("#qty").value)||1));if(!vr){$("#pmsg").textContent="الاختيار ده مش متاح.";return}
const inCart=cart.filter(c=>c.id===id&&names.every(n=>c.opts[n]===opts[n])).reduce((s,c)=>s+c.q,0);if(inCart+q>Math.min(10,vr[1])){$("#pmsg").textContent="الكمية المتاحة من الاختيار ده محدودة.";return}
cart.push({id,opts,q});save();closeM();renderCart();$("#cart").classList.add("open");};}
function closeM(){$("#pm").classList.remove("open")}
const total=()=>cart.reduce((s,i)=>s+price(P.find(p=>p.id===i.id))*i.q,0);
function renderCart(){$("#cc").textContent=cart.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.q,0);
$("#items").innerHTML=cart.length?cart.map((i,n)=>{const p=P.find(x=>x.id===i.id);return `<div class="ci"><img src="${IM(p)}" alt=""><div><b>${p.name}<\/b><small>${Object.entries(i.opts).map(([k,v])=>k+": "+String(v).replace(/^\./,"")).join(" · ")}<\/small><small>${i.q} × ${fmt(price(p))}<\/small><\/div><button class="x2" data-rm="${n}">حذف<\/button><\/div>`}).join(""):"<p class='empty'>السلة فاضية.<\/p>";
$("#tot").textContent=fmt(total());$("#co").disabled=!cart.length;}
function form(){const g=$("#gov");g.innerHTML="<option value=''>اختار المحافظة<\/option>"+Object.keys(AR).map(x=>`<option>${x}<\/option>`).join("");
g.onchange=()=>{$("#area").innerHTML="<option value=''>اختار المنطقة<\/option>"+(AR[g.value]||[]).map(x=>`<option>${x}<\/option>`).join("")};g.onchange();}
async function submit(e){
e.preventDefault();
const f=e.target;const phone=f.phone.value.replace(/\s/g,"");
if(!/^01[0125][0-9]{8}$/.test(phone)){$("#msg").textContent="رقم الموبايل لازم يبقى 11 رقم ويبدأ بـ 01.";return}
if(!cart.length||!f.gov.value||!f.area.value){$("#msg").textContent="اختار المحافظة والمنطقة.";return}
const lines=cart.map(function(i){const p=P.find(function(x){return x.id===i.id});return p.name+" - "+Object.values(i.opts).join(" / ")+" × "+i.q+" = "+(price(p)*i.q)+" جنيه"});
const txt="طلب من "+C.BRAND+":\n"+lines.join("\n")+"\nالإجمالي: "+total()+"\nالاسم: "+f.name.value.trim()+"\nالموبايل: "+phone+"\n"+f.gov.value+" - "+f.area.value+"\n"+f.address.value.trim();
if(C.MESSENGER){window.open(C.MESSENGER,"_blank")}
cart=[];save();renderCart();$("#checkout").classList.remove("open");
$("#done").innerHTML='<div class="mbox"><h2>وصلنا طلبك ✔</h2><p>دي نسخة تجريبية: الطلب مش بيتبعت فعلاً. في المتجر الحقيقي بيتسجل تلقائي وبيوصلك على صفحتك.</p><button class="btn" data-close>تمام</button></div>';
$("#done").classList.add("open");f.reset();
}
document.addEventListener("click",e=>{const t=e.target;
if(t.dataset.c){cat=t.dataset.c;cats();grid()}
if(t.dataset.id)openProduct(t.dataset.id);
if(t.hasAttribute&&t.hasAttribute("data-close")||t.classList.contains("modal"))document.querySelectorAll(".modal").forEach(m=>m.classList.remove("open"));
if(t.dataset.rm){cart.splice(+t.dataset.rm,1);save();renderCart()}
if(t.id==="cartbtn")$("#cart").classList.toggle("open");
if(t.id==="co"){$("#cart").classList.remove("open");$("#sum").textContent="إجمالي الطلب: "+fmt(total())+" (الدفع عند الاستلام)";$("#checkout").classList.add("open")}});
$("#orderform").addEventListener("submit",submit);
cats();grid();renderCart();form();loadStock().then(ok=>{if(ok){grid();renderCart()}});
function deep(){const m=location.hash.match(/^#p(\d+)$/);if(m&&P.find(x=>x.id===m[1]))openProduct(m[1])}
deep();window.addEventListener("hashchange",deep);
document.querySelectorAll("[data-fb]").forEach(a=>a.href=C.FB_PAGE);document.querySelectorAll("[data-ms]").forEach(a=>a.href=C.MESSENGER);
})();
</script></body></html>
